name: story_friendly_fire
description: VMQ05's friendly_fire rule guards Colonel Moore (3 deliberate hits in 10 s, crates/coop-policy/data/policy.json). The host enables him and moves him into the cell. The guest hits him five times in 2 s through its own hit requests (combat::hurt on the guest, then the host ledger). The host runs ffguard::allow_hit on each guest request before the ledger (LiveHostAdapter::hold_guest_hit and guarded_hits): it lets three through and drops the next two, counted on the host as campaign.ff_blocked.
